execution.objective: Implement and qualify a fail-closed verified-feature restoration runner.

first_qualification_case.release_contract: MISSING; runner must stop before target mutation

success_criteria: Validate authority, contract, baseline, candidate, exact paths, patch checksum, and required checks.
Fail closed before target mutation if required release authority is missing or mismatched.
Use only an isolated runner-created worktree.
Run only checks required by a valid release contract.
Create a restoration PR only after all required checks pass.
Verify runner-created temporary worktrees are removed after success and failure.
Never merge, publish, deploy, modify database data, or expand scope.

forbidden_surface: Dashboard application paths during this cycle

test_definition: Verify the PR #7 case stops because no valid release contract exists.
Confirm the blocked run changes no target files.
Verify exact-path enforcement with a synthetic authorized fixture.
Verify runner-created temporary worktrees are cleaned up after success and failure.
Before any later dashboard restoration, sign in as an administrator and verify both tabs and their authorized workflows.
Before any later dashboard restoration, compare Development template fingerprints; cleanup requires separate authorization.
founder_runtime_test.expected_outcome: Founder records PASS or REJECTED with evidence before cycle closure.
